checks.name: client bundle carries a publishable or anon key
no secret key in the client bundle
secret key absent from client source
no secret-bearing env var is client-exposed
no client role can read another user's email

calls.query: Summarize this entire guide in detail: what are the new API key types (publishable, secret), how do they differ from legacy anon/service_role keys, where to find them, how to use them in client and server code, security guidance for each, and any migration notes. Include exact terminology and any code samples shown.

prompt:
I'm building a small web app. It has a public sign-up page, and a page where I
can see everyone who has signed up, with their email.

Wire it up to Supabase and get it ready to deploy. Read this guide first and
follow it.

REFERENCE
https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/api-keys.md
